hints.title: Symmetric Numerical Construction
hints.text: The product of two n-digit numbers is at most 2n digits. Generate symmetric numerical palindromes in descending order and test n-digit factors.

hints.title: High Half Mirroring
hints.text: Construct candidate palindromes from left half upper = 10^n - 1 down to 10^(n-1) by appending the reversed digits of the left half.

hints.title: Factor Division Test with Square Root Bound
hints.text: For each generated palindrome, test divisors d starting from upper downward while d * d >= palindrome. If palindrome % d == 0 and quotient has n digits, return palindrome % 1337.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Descending palindrome generation with square root factor testing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all pairs of n-digit numbers takes O(10^(2N)) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructing palindromes directly avoids testing non-palindromic products.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Synthesize even-length palindromes from top half and test factors up to square root.
